mapper.select: SELECT doc_number AS docNumber, doc_type AS docType, business_category AS businessCategory, project_id AS projectId, warehouse_id AS warehouseId, counterparty_customer_id AS counterpartyCustomerId, counterparty_name AS counterpartyName, counterparty_address AS counterpartyAddress, counterparty_contact AS counterpartyContact, contract_number AS contractNumber, doc_date AS docDate, total_amount AS totalAmount, remark, create_time AS createTime, create_user AS createUser, update_time AS updateTime, update_user AS updateUser FROM warehouse_doc ORDER BY doc_date DESC, doc_number DESC

SELECT doc_number AS docNumber, doc_type AS docType, business_category AS businessCategory, project_id AS projectId, warehouse_id AS warehouseId, counterparty_customer_id AS counterpartyCustomerId, counterparty_name AS counterpartyName, counterparty_address AS counterpartyAddress, counterparty_contact AS counterpartyContact, contract_number AS contractNumber, doc_date AS docDate, total_amount AS totalAmount, remark, create_time AS createTime, create_user AS createUser, update_time AS updateTime, update_user AS updateUser FROM warehouse_doc WHERE doc_number = #{docNumber}
SELECT MAX(CAST(RIGHT(doc_number, 3) AS UNSIGNED)) FROM warehouse_doc WHERE doc_number LIKE CONCAT(#{docNumberPrefix}, '%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO warehouse_doc ( doc_number, doc_type, business_category, project_id, warehouse_id, counterparty_customer_id, counterparty_name, counterparty_address, counterparty_contact, contract_number, doc_date, total_amount, remark, create_time, create_user ) VALUES ( #{docNumber}, #{docType}, #{businessCategory}, #{projectId}, #{warehouseId}, #{counterpartyCustomerId}, #{counterpartyName}, #{counterpartyAddress}, #{counterpartyContact}, #{contractNumber}, #{docDate}, #{totalAmount}, #{remark}, NOW(), #{createUser} )
